_doc: Midjourney prompts for the base-body roster (docs/oracle/moonheroes/BASE_ROSTER.md). Every prompt is STEM with {subject} filled in. Humans and human-like races keep 'bald featureless head'; races with ears, tusks, horns or big heads describe the head in the subject instead.
STEM: low-poly faceted 3D game base mesh of a plain white plastic store display mannequin, smooth sealed featureless surface like an artist's lay figure, smooth flat pelvis, no anatomical detail, like a store display mannequin, no clothing, PG, {subject}, A-pose with arms a little away from the body, full body, front view, square to camera, orthographic, untextured white clay, plain light grey background --ar 2:3
